raw.instruction: Why am I getting an error with my VLOOKUP formula in Excel, and how can I correctly use it to display 'two' in cell F11 when my system uses a semicolon as a separator? Additionally, when I try to drag down the formula to other cells, the range argument increases (such as E6:F11 for the next cell), but I want to maintain the fixed range of E5:F10 for all the cells where I drag the formula. How can I achieve this?       VLOOKUP(E11,E5:E9,6,FALSE)
